description: A timeline of my life and career.
author: Heath Shults
content: This is a timeline of my life and career. It includes my education, my work experience, and some of the projects I've worked on. I hope you find it interesting.

timeline.title: Sessions College for Professional Design
timeline.projects: Graphic Design, Flash and Web Developmen
timeline.description: I thought to myself, "Hmmm... looks like this internet thing might stick around..."

timeline.title: BPAA
timeline.projects: Manage development interactive content for the association's websites • Design & Develop Custom CMS and Hosting System for Bowling Centers websites & email • Design & Develop CRM for members
timeline.description: My first real job as a developer. Web Manager at the Bowling Proprietors' Association of America. Managing projects and developing software solutions. Eventually making it all the way to Director in 2007.

timeline.title: Blue Star Sports
timeline.projects: Design & Develop UI for youth football player tracking system
timeline.description: UI/UX Engineer was a startup company focused on youth football player tracking. I Converted creative assets into functional interactive user interfaces and received my first exposuer to React.js

timeline.title: Fannie Mae
timeline.description: At Fannie Mae I had the pleasure of being a lead on a creative team that was tasked with developing an entire Design System for the entire company to utilize in an effort to standardize best practices, and establish consistency amoung the corporation of over 8000 employees. We called it Blue Print Design System. We used JavaScript, SCSS/CSS and HTML5 on the front end and consumed REST APIs and JSON based data. to create UI and small micro apps for the design system. One of the most interesting things I learned was Design Thinking. I completed the LUMA certification and still utilize LUMA's approach to solving problems to this day.

timeline.title: USAA
timeline.description: Employee Mobile Apps - USAA This was a great opportunity to gain exposure to mobile development. We used Angular and Ionic for the base of the libraries. We worked on 15 different apps and developed a COVID app to check employees for illness before reporting to work. We utilized Git Labs and Gradel for our CI pipeline which compiled to both iOS and Android applications. UI Engineer✶ Focused on User Experience & Design Thinking✶

timeline.title: Alfi, Inc.
timeline.projects: Alfi, the AI powered recognition device advertising platform.
timeline.description: Direct Hire. AI powered recognition devices for seeing and tracking people in order to provide relative ads the next time that person is recognized.

timeline.title: JP Morgan Chase
timeline.description: 90 day contract. Migrate development departments from Angular to React.js.

timeline.title: Pioneer Natural Resources
timeline.description: 6 Month Contract. Manage UI for a reporting tool that could gage how much oil is left in the Permian Basin.

timeline.title: Bank of America
timeline.description: 1 year contract position as an Application Architect IV. I worked on the architectural design and engineering of new portal that replaced an old non reusable legacy app.
